card.name: The word maintenance in dosing
card.fires_on: The word maintenance (or maintain) in dosing instructions, usually right before dose, infusion rate or phase. It also fires on the middle of the word in 'main-tenance'.

modes.label: Maintenance dose or rate
modes.description: The word maintenance used as a modifier before dose, dosage, infusion rate or phase.
modes.example: The<< maintenance>> dose in mL/hr by patient body weight

modes.label: To maintain a effect
modes.description: The verb maintain after 'to' when describing keeping a response or level steady.
modes.example: The dose required to<< maintain>> stable concentrations is 1.9 mg

card.plain: It lights up on the word maintenance when a label talks about the ongoing dose after the starting dose.
